leadText:
Mabel (Japanese: メープル Maple) is a character of the day who appeared in The Bonds of Mega Evolution!. She is a who has an understanding of Mega Evolution.

Mabel lives on Pomace Mountain in an assemblage of tree houses and mainly spends her time picking and arranging flowers. She moves around in a hovercar so she can pick up the flowers she finds easier.

 was sent to Mabel by her grandfather Gurkinn, who had trained under Mabel when he was younger. Gurkinn hoped Mabel would teach Korrina to understand Mega Evolution better after her had gone berserk twice after Mega Evolving. When and arrived at Pomace Mountain, Mabel immediately proposed that Korrina demonstrate her battle prowess. During the match, Lucario once again went berserk, and Mabel ended the match with a gust of . After this, Korrina desperately asked for Mabel's help.

Mabel took Korrina and the group inside her house, and she assigned them to arrange flowers so she could analyze the friendship between the Trainers and their Pokémon. Over the next few days, Mabel had Korrina and the group repeat the same activity, with Korrina becoming increasingly skeptical of Mabel's training methods. One night, Mabel eventually revealed her secret method, admitting that Korrina and Lucario shared one heart but had two different viewpoints, which led to Lucario's outbursts while Mega Evolved.

Later, arrived, stealing and Mabel's Mawile. Korrina Mega Evolved her Lucario to try to save them, but Mega Lucario went berserk once more. Using Mabel's lessons, Korrina stopped Mega Lucario. They were finally able to bond perfectly and broke Mega Lucario's anger. Now completely in sync with Korrina, Mega Lucario saved Pikachu and Mawile, and blasted Team Rocket off with its newly learned . The next day, Korrina thanked Mabel for her teachings, and Mabel gave her one last advice; to continue trying to reach new heights, even though she and Mega Lucario had mastered Mega Evolution now. She bade Korrina and the others farewell.
